name: Stat
need: Dashboards need a KPI tile: a large tabular-numeric value with a caption/label and an optional semantic tone (good/warn/ai). The AI/Run cockpit KPI row and per-team score summary had to hand-roll this.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: Card is the container, not the value/label typography + tone treatment.
MetaItem is a small icon+label meta row, not a headline metric.
Badge is a compact chip; not a large stat value.

decision: Built, as an atom rather than a molecule: it is a value and a caption, and it composes INSIDE a Card rather than being one, which is what dropped it a level. value and label take ReactNode instead of string|number, so a screen can pass a formatted number or a link without a second component. tone, unit and size are as proposed. Closed 2026-08-21; built shortly after the request and never marked.
decidedBy: owner (2026-08-21, asked for the July requests to be settled)
